title: Eco RFID Cards
description: Eco RFID cards in wood, PLA and paper materials for sustainable hotel, membership, access and branded credential programs.
summary: Eco RFID cards use materials such as wood, PLA and paper to give hospitality, membership and branding programs a more sustainable credential option.
The eco RFID cards are typically produced using biodegradable material, such as wood, PLA, paper etc., which help reduce plastic waste.
Despite being eco-friendly, these cards are designed to be durable and long-lasting, ensuring they can withstand everyday use.

faq.question: What are Eco RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for sustainable hospitality, membership, gift-card, and brand programs that want an eco material story without dropping RFID or NFC functionality.
